PolicyDescription: Manager approval is sufficient for standard in-warranty replacements below $500.
Finance approval is required when replacement or credit exposure is between $500 and $1500.
Managers may approve limited goodwill credits for loyal customers shortly after warranty expiration.
Executive approval is required when commercial downtime creates significant customer impact.
Managers may approve small courtesy credits for subscription shipment issues.
Manager approval is sufficient for low-dollar refunds when an accessory arrives damaged and evidence is provided.
